lines.text: Many learners say: She blamed me about the mistake.
Better: She blamed me for the mistake.
For! She blamed me for the mistake.

data.wrong: She blamed me about the mistake.
data.right: She blamed me for the mistake.

publish.title: Stop saying "blamed me about"? Say this instead
publish.value: Say "She blamed me for the mistake", not "She blamed me about the mistake". Use blame someone for something.
